crossRefs.note: He said to Gehazi his servant, “Call this Shunammite.” When he had called her, she stood before him.
Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah…
He who was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.
Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might…

people.name: Gehazi
people.line: Elisha's servant; punished with leprosy for greed and deceit.

people.name: Shunammites
people.line: People from Shunem; includes Abishag and the Shunammite woman

translations.web: He called Gehazi, and said, “Call this Shunammite!” So he called her. When she had come in to him, he said, “Take up your son.”
translations.bsb: Elisha summoned Gehazi and said, “Call the Shunammite woman.” So he called her and she came. Then Elisha said, “Pick up your son.”
translations.kjv: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.
translations.asv: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.
